tabular.purpose: Codes, phone numbers, and counts — never prose.

stat.purpose: The one large-number style for every StatCard/StatRail figure across the app.

label.purpose: 11px uppercase tracked section labels (sidebar headers, stat labels); also used plain for the smallest captions.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Low separation for white cards against the slate-50 page ground.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid blue fill, white text — the app's one accent color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill — Live
components.description: Any non-terminal lifecycle status — soft blue tint pill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip-live { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Status Pill — Won
components.css: .ds-chip-pos { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: #f0fdf4; color: #166534; }

components.name: Status Pill — Lost
components.css: .ds-chip-neg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: #fef2f2; color: #991b1b; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard white container on the slate-50 page ground.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.8); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); padding: 20px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active state is a tinted background plus accent text — the standard SaaS nav pattern, no colored shell or marker bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #475569; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #1d4ed8; background: #eff6ff; }

narrative.overview: A deliberately conventional light SaaS admin look, chosen after an earlier dark-shell 'scorecard' direction was rejected as poor-looking. White content on a soft gray ground, one restrained blue accent, and standard soft-tint status pills — the visual language most CRM/ops tools already use, executed with care rather than novelty.
keyCharacteristics: White sidebar/topbar/cards on a soft gray page background
One blue accent (brand-600), used only for primary actions, active nav, links, and focus rings
Soft-tint rounded-full status pills, not solid blocks
Standard 8-12px corner radii; pills stay fully rounded
Tabular IBM Plex Mono reserved for codes, phone numbers, and counts only

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only accent color used for interactive/primary meaning; a second competing accent color is a regression to the rejected direction.

rules.name: The Soft Pill Rule
rules.body: Every status/lifecycle badge is a light-tint background with same-hue darker text, fully rounded — never a solid block.

dos: Do keep the sidebar and topbar white with a hairline border.
Do use brand-600/brand-700 as the only accent, always paired with white text on solid fills.
Do use soft-tint rounded-full pills for every status badge.
Do keep IBM Plex Mono to codes, phone numbers, and counts.
donts: Don't reintroduce a dark or colored sidebar/topbar shell.
Don't use a solid, high-contrast block for a status badge.
Don't introduce a second accent color competing with blue.
Don't put dark text on the accent fill, or white text on a light accent tint.
